purpose: GENERALIZED inline-create contract for interactive intake pick-lists. When the intake shows a `kind:config` pick-list (via mcp_resolution_map.json interactive_resolutions) and the value the user wants does NOT exist, this map tells the orchestrator + FE whether that `need` can be created inline, WHICH create mechanism to use, and the MINIMAL fields to collect. It is the symmetric sibling of the FETCH map (interactive_resolutions): fetch lists options, create adds one. Consumed by backend resolve.createOption() (this repo) and, in wave-2, by the orchestrator (phases.js) + FE (cards.js) to render a 'Create ' affordance next to 'Refresh'.
grounding: Every create_tool / dc_post endpoint below is GROUNDED against real source — MCP write tools verified in Project-WF/mcp-auth-token/src/mastra/tools/**; job/project/request status create endpoints verified in Project-WF/zuper-webapp-v3/projects/settings (settings.service.ts + *-status-form.component.ts). status_type enum option lists copied verbatim from the Angular settings forms. Nothing here is invented — entities without a confirmed API create path are recorded with create_tool:null + reason so the FE hides 'Create' for them.

mechanisms.mcp_write: create_tool is a Zuper product MCP write tool id (create_* family). resolve.createOption dispatches via gateway.callWrite(create_tool, args) — bypasses the read-only build policy, orchestrator-only, approval-gated by the caller. The MCP tool handles its own request-body wrapper.
mechanisms.dc_post: No MCP write tool exists — create is a direct authenticated POST to the Zuper DC API via gateway.dcPost. The `dc_post` block gives the path (with {token} args substituted from `args`), the request-body wrapper key that required_fields nest under, and any top-level body_extra fields sourced from `args`.

field_conventions.required_fields: Fields the FE must collect from the user before create. `key` = the exact create-input key (MCP tool arg name for mcp_write; body field under dc_post.body_wrapper for dc_post). `type` drives the input widget. `enum` (when present) is the exact allowed {label,value} set. `default` (when present) is applied by resolve.createOption if the user leaves it blank — so a field with a default is effectively optional to the user. `from_prior_answer` = the value comes from an already-resolved prior answer / fetch arg (e.g. a parent category_uid), NOT fresh user input.
field_conventions.conditional_fields: Fields the FE collects ONLY when a sibling field's value is in `required_when.in` (dependent-field reveal). Same `key`/`type` semantics as required_fields. `required_when.field` names the sibling driver key and `required_when.in` the values that make this field shown AND required; otherwise it stays hidden and unrequired. `type:'options'` is a repeatable list widget whose collected value is a `string[]` (blank entries dropped). Consumed by resolve.createOption (thread the key through to the create call) and by the FE (CreateOptionForm renders the widget + gates the create button).
field_conventions.arg_from_context: Create-tool args (mcp_write) whose value is threaded from the interactive fetch `args` / a prior answer rather than collected from the user. `tool_arg` = the create-tool arg name; `from` = the key to read out of `args`.
field_conventions.parent_arg: Mirrors the interactive_resolutions `parent` — the need whose resolved value must exist before create (e.g. job_status needs the job_category's category_uid). `provides` names the arg key it supplies.
field_conventions.company_id / token: Multi-tenancy is threaded by resolve.createOption exactly like fetchOptions — company_id scopes any cache bust; token is the logged-in user's bearer passed to gateway.callWrite / gateway.dcPost.

capabilities.note: No MCP tool — POST /jobs/status_new/{category_uid} body { job_status: { status_name, status_type, status_color } }. Verified in zuper-webapp-v3 settings.service.ts (newJobStatusUrl) + job-status-form.component.ts (Validators.required on status_name/status_type/status_color; status_type list copied verbatim). Per-category: the parent job_category's category_uid is the path arg.

capabilities.reason: trigger_status options are SYSTEM status-type enum buckets read live from the module's meta/filter DROPDOWN (company-independent system values, not account records). There is nothing to create — the buckets are fixed by Zuper. If the user wants a NAMED per-account status they should use the module-specific need (job_status / project_status / request_status) which is creatable.

capabilities.note: No MCP tool — POST /projects/status body { project_category_uid, project_status: { project_status_name, project_status_type, project_status_color } }. Verified in zuper-webapp-v3 settings.service.ts (projectStatusUrl) + project-status-form.component.ts (project_category_uid is a TOP-LEVEL body key, statuses nest under project_status; Validators.required on name/type/color; status_type list copied verbatim). Per-category: parent project_category supplies category_uid → project_category_uid.

No MCP tool — POST /request/status body { request_status: { status_name, status_type, status_color } }. Account-wide (NOT per-category, unlike job/project). Verified in zuper-webapp-v3 settings.service.ts (requestStatusUrl) + request-status-form.component.ts + request-status.interface.ts (status_type enum copied verbatim).
POST /team (MCP create_team). Optional: team_color, team_description, user_uids.

POST /user (MCP create_user). allow_user_set_password defaults true → an INVITE is sent; emp_code/designation derived; role_name resolved to role_id via /user/roles. Some accounts hard-block API user creation (400) → FE falls back to manual + Refresh. Name may be collected as a single 'Full name' and split into first/last by the FE/orchestrator.
Same MCP create_user as `user`, but role_name defaults to Admin (the pick-list itself is ADMIN-role filtered on fetch).
Same MCP create_user as `user`, but role_name defaults to Technician (the pick-list itself is FIELD_EXECUTIVE-role filtered on fetch).

POST /projects/category (MCP create_project_category). fixed_args.auto_create_status=true seeds default statuses so a freshly-created category is immediately usable by the dependent project_status pick-list. Optional: category_description, category_color.

POST /organization (MCP create_organization). Only organization_name is required by the tool; email/contact/pricelist etc. are optional. This is a DATA entity (not account config) — enable the inline-create affordance only if the product wants it; otherwise the FE may keep it search-only.

POST /settings/custom_fields/new (MCP create_custom_field). module_name is threaded from the interactive fetch arg `module` (the custom_field need already requires_args:['module']). field_type defaults SINGLE_LINE. The dropdown/radio types SINGLE_ITEM/MULTI_ITEM/RADIO additionally require field_options — a `string[]` collected by the FE via the conditional_fields `options` widget (shown only for those field_types) and threaded verbatim to the create_custom_field arg `field_options`. Collect nothing extra for the scalar field_types.

capabilities.reason: A NEW/one-off service task does NOT need an inline master-create here: the JOB update SERVICE_TASK action natively accepts a CUSTOM task inline — service_task:[{ is_custom_task:true, service_task_title, service_task_description?, estimated_duration? }] with NO master uid (grounded via describe_module_action(JOB,update,SERVICE_TASK) + mcp-server/captures/zuper_action_schema.json). So the intake captures a free-text service_task_title and the node-builder builds is_custom_task:true; nothing is created up-front. A create_service_tasks MCP tool DOES exist (id 'create_service_tasks', endpoint POST /service_tasks, required 'service_task_title'), but its inputSchema wraps tasks in an ARRAY (`service_tasks:[{ service_task_title, ... }]`) whereas resolve.createOption's mcp_write path sends FLAT fields keyed by required_fields[].key — it has no array-wrapper — so wiring create_service_tasks as an inline mcp_write Create affordance would fail the tool's Zod validation. Leave creatable:false until createOption supports an array-wrapped tool arg (owned by the orchestrator/resolve layer); the account-level service-task MASTER pick (need:service_task in mcp_resolution_map.json) stays search-only + ↻ Refresh, and CUSTOM tasks go through the native is_custom_task path (no create step).

capabilities.note: POST /company_tags (MCP create_tag). Optional module_uid to scope. NOTE: the mcp_resolution_map tag note said 'no create tool wired' — that is now stale; create_tag exists on the MCP surface.
POST /invoice_estimate/tax (MCP create_tax). tax_rate is a number (0 valid). Optional: is_local_tax, applicable_to.
POST /invoice_estimate/tax_groups (MCP create_tax_group). Optional taxes[] (each { tax_uid, type: APPLICABLE|EXEMPT }) to seed the bundle — collect only if the product wants it.
POST /vendors (MCP create_vendor). Master VendorSchema enforces vendor_email (valid format) + vendor_contact_name as required — hence 3 fields, not 1. vendor_display_name defaults to vendor_name.

capabilities.reason: create_product exists on the MCP, but a product is a catalog entity that needs a category and pricing context to be usable, and inline-creating it from a workflow pick-list would produce an underspecified record. User creates the product in Zuper + Refresh. (Enable later with create_product if a richer inline form is desired.)

create_pricelist requires pricelist_type (FIXED_DISCOUNT/FIXED_MARGIN/PER_ITEM) plus a value or line_items[] with product refs — not a name-only create. Out of scope for an inline pick-list create; user creates it in Zuper + Refresh.
Templates carry rich document content/layout; there is no name-only create path and no create_proposal_template MCP tool. User authors it in Zuper + Refresh.
PDF/document SEND templates carry rich layout content; no create_document_template MCP tool. User authors it in Zuper + Refresh.
Email templates carry subject/body/merge content; no create_email_template MCP tool. User authors it in Zuper + Refresh.
No create tool for time-off request TYPES is exposed on the MCP surface (create_timeoff_request creates a request, not a type). User configures the type in Zuper timesheet settings + Refresh.

expense_category is fetched read-only via DC GET /expenses/category; no create tool/endpoint was confirmed. User creates it in Zuper expense settings + Refresh. (If a POST /expenses/category is later confirmed, convert to a dc_post entry.)
measurement_category is fetched read-only via DC GET /measurements/categories; no create tool/endpoint was confirmed. User creates it in Zuper measurement settings + Refresh.
